title_zh: 一次前向胜过两次：用于精准高效 GUI 定位的 InnerZoom
one_line: Single-forward grounding that re-injects intermediate-layer target-region evidence into decoding; offline grounding benchmarks with same-data baseline and latency/TFLOPs versus two-pass zoom.
one_line_zh: 在单次前向中提取中间层目标区域证据并跨层注入坐标解码，在六个离线定位基准上优于同数据基线与两遍放大法，且延迟更低。

online_eval.quote: We report results on six GUI grounding benchmarks spanning desktop, mobile, and web interfaces

strong_baselines.quote: We compare InnerZoom with representative GUI grounding models, such as MAI-UI ( Zhou et al., 2025a ) , UI-Ins ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , GTA1 ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , UI-TARS ( Seed, 2025 )

budget_matched.quote: Under the same 4B setting, InnerZoom outperforms the two-pass Base SFT+RL + Zoom-In baseline on UI-V, OSW-GR, and OSW-G by +3.8, +0.6, and +1.9 points, respectively, while being slightly lower on SS-Pro.

cost_reported.quote: InnerZoom achieves stronger accuracy on most benchmarks while staying close to the base model, requiring only 1.18 – 1.27\times latency and 1.16 – 1.23\times TFLOPs.

component_ablation.quote: Base SFT+RL uses the original Qwen3-VL backbone with the same SFT+RL framework and training data, but without our proposed designs.

code.quote: Code and models will be publicly available.

evidence_level.quote: where a prediction is counted as correct if the predicted coordinate falls inside the target bounding box

S1.quote: Compared with the strongest prior result on each benchmark, InnerZoom improves OSW-GR, OSW-G, SS-V2, SS-Pro, UI-V, and MMB-GUI by 2.9, 4.1, 0.3, 1.1, 3.2, and 2.3 points, respectively.

S2.quote: Base SFT+RL uses the original Qwen3-VL backbone with the same SFT+RL framework and training data, but without our proposed designs.

S5.quote: Compared with Zoom-In, this reduces latency by 23.8 – 35.7\% and TFLOPs by 26.0 – 32.0\% , cutting most of the additional overhead introduced by repeated inference.

F6.quote: We evaluate InnerZoom using action accuracy ( Yang et al., 2025a ) , where a prediction is counted as correct if the predicted coordinate falls inside the target bounding box.

title_zh: LUMOS：面向无障碍信息落地 AI 智能体的语义操作系统层
one_line: Converts UIA/DOM accessibility metadata into id-indexed semantic blueprints for a one-action LLM loop; only case studies and regression tests, no benchmark evaluation.
